I've replaced **every single mountain image** with verified photos sourced directly from **Wikimedia Commons / Wikipedia**. These are the official images used on each mountain's Wikipedia article, so they are guaranteed to show the correct mountain.

Key changes:
- **Grandes Jorasses** — now shows the actual north face from Wikipedia
- **All 7 Summits** — verified Wikipedia images (Everest, Aconcagua, Denali, Kilimanjaro, Elbrus, Vinson, Carstensz)
- **All 14 eight-thousanders** — verified (K2, Kangchenjunga, Lhotse, Makalu, etc.)
- **All Alps peaks** — verified (Mont Blanc, Matterhorn, Eiger, Jungfrau, Gran Paradiso, Monte Rosa, Weisshorn, Dom, Grossglockner, Zugspitze, Dent Blanche, Aiguille Verte, Triglav)
- **All Andes peaks** — verified (Ojos del Salado, Huascaran, Chimborazo, Cotopaxi, Illimani, Fitz Roy, Cerro Torre, etc.)
- **All Colorado 14ers** — verified (Elbert, Massive, Harvard, Longs Peak, Pikes Peak, Capitol, Maroon Bells, etc.)
- **All Himalayan & World Classics** — verified (Ama Dablam, Machapuchare, Rainier, Fuji, Ararat, Kinabalu, etc.)

Every image now comes from a verified, curated source where the mountain has been correctly identified by Wikipedia editors. No more mismatched photos.
